Step 3 needs one correction to my draft and one to step 2. The draft tick buried the SMS follow-up and the batch-size watch in a closed checkbox, where the triage never looks. Your final-review rulings are deferred work, so step 1's "nothing deferred" was wrong. They go in as their own items, and the plan's status header changes to match. Both rulings are already yours, so I don't need to ask anything first.

<edit path="specs/deferred_items.md">
Replace the first item of `## 11-overdue-notices — 2026-10-02` with:

- [x] Reminder e-mails open one SMTP connection per message, so the nightly
      run takes about 40 minutes for 9,000 loans. See
      specs/plans/completed/11-overdue-notices.md; touches notices/mailer.py.
      → done in plan 15 (e-mail only; SMS follow-up is in the 15-reminder-batching section below)

Append at the end of the file, after the `13-branch-hours` section:

## 15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30
- [ ] SMS reminders still make one gateway call per message; they need the
      same batching plan 15 gave e-mail. Kept out of plan 15 by the owner
      (final review), who wants it done next. See
      specs/plans/completed/15-reminder-batching.md. Size: plan. Done when:
      SMS reminders are sent in batches and the nightly run makes no
      per-message gateway calls.
- [ ] Reminder batch size is fixed at 50 (plan 15). The owner ruled it stays
      until the mail host rejects a batch. See
      specs/plans/completed/15-reminder-batching.md. Size: quick-fix.
      Revisit if: the mail host rejects a batch with `421 Too many messages`.

**Message to my partner:**

Plan 15 is executed and its final review is resolved. I'm partway through the completion protocol, and I need to correct something I said earlier.

- **Ticked:** the one-SMTP-connection-per-message item from `11-overdue-notices`, as `→ done in plan 15`. I'd drafted a long note on that tick covering SMS and the batch size. Ticked items are never triaged, so that note would have buried both. They are now separate items.
- **New section `15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30`**, two items from your rulings:
  1. SMS batching. Size `plan`, since it's the same work as e-mail and only needs sequencing. It's done when no per-message gateway calls remain. Tell me if you'd rather treat it as `design`.
  2. The batch size of 50. Size `quick-fix`, revisit if the mail host rejects a batch with `421 Too many messages`.
- **Correction:** at step 1 I said nothing was deferred, and I wrote "nothing deferred" in the plan's status header. Both items are your rulings from the review, so the header now says `deferred items in specs/deferred_items.md`.

I haven't touched the two older open items (the fines timezone one and the holiday feed). Next I'll run the backlog stats and triage (step 4), then retire the plan (step 5).
